svg.aria-label: CodeAtlas. Local CLI · merged 6 Oct. Green tests don’t always mean nothing broke. CodeAtlas finds the tests a change really reaches, runs the code before and after, and signs what it saw. Built with TypeScript, Node.js and Vitest. The screenshot shows the evidence workspace on a fixture repository.
